title: KARMA Lantern Brief
$comment: Finite structural, normalized-view, stage, and behavior coupling schema. Canonical lantern.validate_brief recomposition is still required to verify derived policy trace, uncertainty, stage selection, and frozen explanations.

const.title: Normalize · 規整
const.description: Accept one strict finite event and no raw payload.

const.title: Separate · 分明
const.description: Separate signals, declarations, inferences, uncertainties, and explicit unknowns.

const.title: Interpret · 解讀
const.description: Copy the unchanged KARMA stage and label its route, capability, friction, and recovery steps as advisory display values.

const.title: Explain · 說明
const.description: Use the finite Cloudbell signature to explain the mechanism, never a person.

const.title: Respond · 應對
const.description: Present three reviewed reversible options for a human decision and execute none.

const.title: Learn · 共學
const.description: Open a normalized replay, regression target, architecture question, and closure requirements.

This brief explains one normalized event and does not prove that a real incident occurred.
It names a behavior pattern, never a person, identity, intent, guilt, worth, affiliation, or reputation.
Its review priorities are posture labels, not clocks, queue positions, elapsed-time measurements, or guarantees.
Its stage, route, capability, friction, and recovery-step values are advisory displays, not evidence that enforcement happened.
Its options are inert proposals and authorize or execute no infrastructure action.
Its replay and learning fields create no stored incident, test, ticket, policy change, or external message.
It provides no monitoring coverage, prevention claim, security guarantee, legal conclusion, or completion claim.
